title: AMD Chief Sees Very High Demand, Urges AI Firms to Cooperate
key_facts: Lisa Su says AMD demand remains ahead of available capacity.
AMD raised output in 2026 and plans another major increase in 2027.
Su is visiting Taiwan, met Foxconn and was due to meet TSMC.
AMD is working with memory-chip suppliers to secure components.
Su expects high demand for several years and needs more advanced wafer capacity; planning three to five years ahead.
She called for greater cooperation among major AI companies on safety.
quote_evidence: AMD is preparing for a larger supply push in 2027 as Chief Executive Lisa Su says demand for its processors remains ahead of available capacity.
She said the company is now planning three to five years ahead to prepare for customer requirements.
Su also called for greater cooperation among major AI companies on safety as adoption of the technology grows.
why_it_matters_hint: Supply for AI chips stays tight for years, per AMD's chief.
notes: Bloomberg blocked; Reuters report of same day already in 6 Oct edition.
